relations: The white translucent mass expands outward into the empty left, right, and lower compartments of the blue tray.
Internal radial lines and the central pale spot remain fixed as the mass's outer boundary grows.
The blue tray, wooden surface, and plate edge maintain static positions while the white mass slowly enlarges.
caption: A blue plastic tray with internal vertical divider bars rests on a scratched wooden surface dotted with water droplets, while a white plate edge stays fixed at the bottom-left. Inside sits a white, translucent, fan-shaped mass whose surface shows faint radial lines converging on a small pale spot near its top center, the blue bars seen through it. The camera holds still; the tray, its bars, the wood, and the plate edge keep the same image positions. The white mass slowly grows outward, its left boundary creeping into the empty left compartment. On the opposite side its right edge advances rightward into the empty right compartment. The lower bulge extends slightly downward, widening the white region against the blue. The radial lines and central spot stay fixed as the outline expands, and no object enters or leaves.
